nina-marketing: Hey eng/runtime  quick rerun request for the webinar deck: run a 400-sample rerank smoke (n=4 candidates) and give per-candidate median+p95 latencies + overall MRR@4. Want float vs quantized and note hardware. Target S3: s3://redwood-prod/benchmarks/webinar/2026-03/rerank/. Can you do cached runs only and one cold mini-run (30 samples) for appendix?

oleg-eng-runtime: Got it. We'll do float32 and 8-bit quant, cached primary, cold mini-run 30 as requested. Any seq_len cap?

tara-eng-runtime: Plan: deterministic 400 sample pull, truncate >4096, run rerank harness, output CSVs and a 1-paragraph methods.txt. Repro command below:

```
tools/bench/run_rerank.sh \
  --s3 s3://redwood-prod/benchmarks/webinar/2026-03/rerank/ \
  --samples 400 \
  --model redwood-rerank-v1 \
  --candidates 4 \
  --quantized both \
  --cache-mode cached \
  --cold-samples 30 \
  --output gs://bench-results/webinar/1953300001/
```

bench-bot: Job queued id=jb-20260323-9012 pos=4 est start 9m.

[~1h later]

tara-eng-runtime: Run finished. Uploaded rerank-400.csv, rerank-30-cold.csv, methods.txt to gs://bench-results/webinar/1953300001/. Key numbers: MRR@4 = 0.63; per-candidate median(ms) = [10,12,14,16]; per-candidate p95(ms) = [40,48,60,90]; quantized speedup median = 1.5x; token-delta on heldout-100 = 0.5%. Used 2x A40 for cached run, A100 for quant check. Dropped legacy-schema rows = 5/400.

oleg-eng-runtime: Added small CSV top10-quant-affected for comms to vet. No schema anomalies beyond the dropped rows.

nina-marketing: Perfect  will draft slide copy and include the methods blurb. Thanks all :sparkles:
